2607.09611.title: Toward Real-Time Sentence-Level Sign Language Translation
2607.09611.paper_summary: Most sign language understanding systems operate at the level of isolated signs, limiting their usefulness in natural communication. We study sentence-level sign language translation (SLT) with the primary goal of real-time deployment rather than proposing a new translation architecture. We fine-tune a SHuBERT-ByT5 translation stack on a uniformly sampled 9,872-example subset of How2Sign, selected because of compute and storage constraints, using QLoRA while keeping SHuBERT frozen. The model obtains a validation BLEU of 16.7 and, on the test split, BLEU 15.9 and BLEURT 44.7. The main contribution is a hardware-aware streaming system: a Raspberry Pi 4B reference client provides camera capture, local text display, and speech output, while compute-intensive perception and translation run on a CPU/GPU backend. The capture protocol remains client-agnostic, so the same backend can serve a browser, phone, or laptop. Chunked ingestion, bounded queues, parallelized perception, temporal reordering, and a sentence-boundary state machine reduce mean post-finalization response latency from 1.873 to 1.354 seconds (27.71%) and P95 latency from 2.919 to 2.130 seconds (27.03%) over the complete 9,872-example working subset.
2607.09611.paper_summary_zh: 大多數手語理解系統在孤立手勢的層面上運作，限制了它們在自然交流中的實用性。<lb/>我們研究句子級手語翻譯（SLT），主要目標是實時部署，而不是提出一種新的翻譯架構。<lb/>我們在一個均勻抽樣的 9,872 範例子集上微調 SHuBERT-ByT5 翻譯堆疊，選擇這個子集是基於計算和存儲的限制，使用 QLoRA，同時保持 SHuBERT 凍結。<lb/>該模型在驗證集上獲得了 16.7 的 BLEU 分數，在測試集上則為 15.9 的 BLEU 分數和 44.7 的 BLEURT 分數。<lb/>主要貢獻是一個硬體感知的串流系統：一個 Raspberry Pi 4B 參考客戶端提供相機捕捉、本地文本顯示和語音輸出，而計算密集型的感知和翻譯則在 CPU/GPU 後端運行。<lb/>捕捉協議保持客戶端不可知，因此相同的後端可以服務於瀏覽器、手機或筆記型電腦。<lb/>分塊攝取、有界佇列、並行感知、時間重排序和句子邊界狀態機將平均後期響應延遲從 1.873 秒減少到 1.354 秒（27.71%），而 P95 延遲則從 2.919 秒減少到 2.130 秒（27.03%），這是在完整的 9,872 範例工作子集上進行的。
2607.09611.author: Thanh-Hoang Nguyen Doan et.al.
